legal_status: Not a legal norm. A published data standard defines both fields; a result here is never a finding of legal compliance or breach.
instrument: Open Contracting Data Standard 1.1.5, release schema
calendar_basis: Civil dates as published, each in its own stated offset

tender_end.text: The period when the tender is open for submissions. The end date is the closing date for tender submissions.

award_date.text: The date of the contract award. This is usually the date on which a decision to award was made.

open.text: All interested suppliers can submit a tender.

selective.text: Only qualified suppliers are invited to submit a tender.

direct.text: The contract is awarded to a single supplier without competition.

limited.text: The procuring entity contacts a number of suppliers of its choice.
